title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
description: Ten named destinations along the streets that frame SMU’s nearby orbit, each with one documented reason to stop.

cards.title: Snider Plaza — browse one compact directory
cards.subtitle: Hillcrest Avenue corridor, west of campus
cards.notes: Walk Hillcrest Avenue to Snider Plaza and use the plaza directory to choose one shop, restaurant, or service before you go.
cards.short_summary: A named retail plaza with a current tenant directory.
cards.evidence_claim: Snider Plaza’s official directory lists its address as 6925 Snider Plaza and identifies shops, restaurants, and services.
cards.access_notes: Consult individual tenant pages for availability and access details.

cards.title: SMU/Mockingbird Station — connect to three rail lines
cards.subtitle: Mockingbird Lane corridor, east of campus
cards.notes: Use the station as a rail connection point and check DART service updates before departing; it serves Red, Blue, and Orange lines.
cards.short_summary: A DART station on the Mockingbird Lane and US 75 corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: DART states that SMU/Mockingbird Station is at Mockingbird Lane and North Central Expressway and is served by the Red, Orange, and Blue Rail lines.
cards.source_title: DART — Mockingbird Station Renamed SMU/Mockingbird Station
cards.access_notes: Verify schedules, fares, and service changes with DART before travel.

cards.title: Mockingbird Station — use the on-site directory
cards.subtitle: East Mockingbird Lane corridor, east of campus
cards.notes: Follow East Mockingbird Lane to the mixed-use center, then use its directory map to identify a current shop or entertainment venue.
cards.short_summary: A mixed-use destination with more than 35 listed eateries, shops, and entertainment venues.
cards.evidence_claim: Mockingbird Station’s visitor page describes a mixed-use development with over 35 eateries, shops, and entertainment venues.
cards.access_notes: Individual businesses set their own hours, prices, and entry policies.

cards.title: Angelika Film Center & Cafe — check the specialty-film program
cards.subtitle: East Mockingbird Lane corridor at Mockingbird Station
cards.notes: Check current listings before walking over; Angelika is listed in the center’s entertainment directory as an eight-screen complex.
cards.short_summary: A named eight-screen film venue within Mockingbird Station.
cards.evidence_claim: Mockingbird Station identifies Angelika Film Center & Cafe as an eight-screen complex devoted to independent and specialty film.
cards.source_title: Mockingbird Station — Angelika Film Center & Cafe
cards.access_notes: Tickets and film ratings vary; review the current program before visiting.

cards.title: Glencoe Park — bring a ball or take the trails
cards.subtitle: Martel Avenue corridor, southeast of campus
cards.notes: Head to Martel Avenue for a park visit: choose the trail, tennis court, outdoor basketball court, or picnic tables listed by Dallas Parks.
cards.short_summary: A 14.1-acre Dallas park with trails and several outdoor recreation features.
cards.evidence_claim: Dallas Park & Recreation lists Glencoe Park at 5300 Martel with trails, tennis, outdoor basketball, picnic tables, and a playground.
cards.access_notes: Use the City’s facility page for current conditions and any field or court restrictions.

cards.title: Centennial Park — look for the open-air gazebo
cards.subtitle: University Boulevard corridor, north of campus
cards.notes: Walk University Boulevard to the park and pause at the open-air gazebo; the city also lists trails, picnic facilities, and practice soccer fields.
cards.short_summary: A University Boulevard park centered on an open-air gazebo.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of University Park identifies Centennial Park at 3800 University Boulevard and lists an open-air gazebo, picnic facility, trails, and practice soccer fields.
cards.source_title: City of University Park — Centennial (formerly Goar) Park
cards.access_notes: Gazebo and field use may be reserved; confirm availability with the city.

cards.title: Burleson Park — choose a court or short trail
cards.subtitle: University Boulevard corridor, north of campus
cards.notes: Use University Boulevard to reach the park, then select the walking trail, basketball court, baseball diamond, or tennis courts listed by the city.
cards.short_summary: A University Boulevard park with multiple court and field facilities.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of University Park lists Burleson Park at 3000 University Boulevard with a baseball field, basketball court, tennis courts, and walking/jogging trail.
cards.source_title: City of University Park — Burleson Park
cards.access_notes: Court lighting and field availability can vary; check city guidance before organized use.

cards.title: Caruth Park — follow the walking trail by the pond
cards.subtitle: Hillcrest Avenue corridor, north of campus
cards.notes: Travel Hillcrest Avenue to Caruth Park and take the walking/jogging trail around its Turtle Creek pond; observe posted pond rules.
cards.short_summary: A large city park with a walking trail, pond, and lighted tennis courts.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of University Park lists Caruth Park at 7801 Hillcrest with a fishing lake, walking/jogging trail, tennis courts, and playgrounds.
cards.source_title: City of University Park — Caruth Park
cards.access_notes: The city says the trail is open for walking and jogging from 6 a.m. to 11 p.m.; fishing rules apply.

cards.title: University Park Public Library — plan around browsing hours
cards.subtitle: Preston Center Plaza corridor, northwest of campus
cards.notes: Go to Preston Center Plaza during published browsing hours and use the library’s collections or ask staff for help locating materials.
cards.short_summary: A public library with Tuesday–Saturday browsing hours and local collections.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of University Park lists the library at 8383 Preston Center Plaza, Suite 200, with published Tuesday–Saturday browsing hours.
cards.source_title: City of University Park — University Park Public Library
cards.access_notes: Published hours: Tue–Thu 10 a.m.–8 p.m.; Fri–Sat 10 a.m.–5 p.m.; closed Sun–Mon.

cards.title: Germany Park — use the conditioning track
cards.subtitle: Lomo Alto Drive and University Boulevard corridor, west of campus
cards.notes: Reach the Lomo Alto and University Boulevard corner for the rubberized track or outdoor fitness area; keep the track’s lane-use guidance in mind.
cards.short_summary: A city park with a rubberized track, outdoor fitness area, and lighted tennis court.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of University Park identifies Germany Park at 6401 Lomo Alto Drive and describes its rubberized track, outdoor fitness area, and lighted tennis court.
cards.source_title: City of University Park — Germany Park
cards.access_notes: Follow the city’s posted track lane guidance; court access and lighting may be subject to city rules.
